purpose: Test whether the AutoCon objective improves the lightweight plain MambaTS backbone without adding inference-path modules.
research_question: Can MambaTSAutoCon preserve plain MambaTS fixed-shape speed while improving validation accuracy across low- and high-dimensional datasets?
architecture_boundary: Both arms use the local MambaTS v1 patch/variable-scan backbone and identical stride-24 geometry. Only the candidate enables the train-time AutoCon relation objective; prediction fusion, ACF memory, and all v3 context/persistence extensions are disabled.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or held-out release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This matrix can support only a local AutoCon-on/off comparison and fixed-shape resource boundary. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, official MambaTS reproduction, universal speed, or causal generalization.

required_before_launch: verify four dataset fingerprints and exact 24-job expansion

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Only AutoCon enablement differs between arms. Dataset, split, architecture, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds are frozen before launch.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both arms share the same v1 MambaTS backbone, patch geometry, split, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: MambaTSAutoCon enables only train-time AutoCon lambda=.001; return_repr is false in prediction-only resource measurement.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: MambaTS disables AutoCon and all candidate-only representation paths.

phases.name: mambats_autocon_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Plain MambaTS v1 backbone with train-time AutoCon objective.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report every paired cell and separately report resource measurements with return_repr=false.

stopping_rules: Keep ETTh1 as a mandatory failure-boundary cell.
Do not infer AutoCon causality from candidate/plain differences without a separate mechanism control.
Do not generate or inspect held-out artifacts.
